name: Chong Hong Construction Co., Ltd.
summary: Chong Hong Construction Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the construction, sale, and leasing of residential and commercial buildings in Taiwan. It operates in two segments, Building and Construction. The company leases factories; and undertakes civil engineering and construction, project contracting. It is also involved in general merchandise retail trade and department store and office rental business. In addition, the company offers rental and sale of industrial plants. Chong Hong Construction Co., Ltd. was founded in 1973 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
